key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:7324
name: restore_directory_and_unlock
description: When the saved lock flag is set, it clears that flag and the saved lock value, then calls the DOS CurrentDir and UnLock routines in turn to restore the directory and release the lock.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:735C
name: calibrate_timer_and_reset_state
description: Times a wait loop by counting its iterations, derives a timing value from the count, clears a 32-entry table and the related state words, and stores the value. It also touches the interrupt enable register.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:7434
name: read_bytes_until_marker
description: Reads bytes until the marker value 143 appears, then sets a status word to 399 and waits for its low bit before returning 399. If the marker was already seen, it reads up to the next marker, clears three pending flags and returns the last value.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:7474
name: skip_to_marker_byte
description: When the enable flag is set, it reads one value and then keeps reading until the low byte equals 143, returning the final value. Otherwise it returns zero.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:74AE
name: setup_continue_menu_state
description: In the normal mode it copies newline-separated entries and resets counter and timer words. In mode two it waits for a menu choice below three, converts that digit to a number and sets the lives count, with the referenced text '3 lives' and 'CONTINUE FROM' shown on that screen.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:774E
name: dispatch_script_commands
description: Reads four-letter command tags from a script, decoded from packed 5-bit letters, and dispatches pict, draw, text, wait, play, done, dark, show, hide, loop, rest and tile. Each tag copies a name into a buffer, sets a timer, rewinds the script, or shifts colour bits in a block of buffer words.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:77EE
name: run_commands_with_copper
description: Runs the same command loop as the routine before it, then installs a copper list through the start routine and writes the background colour register. It also refers to the text gloomgame.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:799A
name: copy_line_and_count_length
description: Copies bytes from the script read position into the output buffer up to a newline, replaces the newline with a terminator, and returns the number of characters before it.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:7A00
name: run_pending_action_pair
description: Checks two pending-action slots: each slot that is set is cleared and its stored routine is called, and the result of the second routine is returned, or zero if the second slot was empty.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:7A04
name: run_pending_action_pair
description: A second entry point to the same two-slot pending-action check: it clears each set slot, calls its stored routine, and returns the second routine's result.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:7A08
name: run_pending_action_pair
description: Same two-slot pending-action check as its neighbours, using the same pair of slots: clears and calls each set routine, then returns the second routine's result or zero.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:7A3A
name: run_alternate_action_pair
description: Like the two-slot pending-action check but on a different pair of slots: clears and calls the first stored routine when set, then returns the result of the second when set, otherwise zero.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:7AD0
name: load_floor_and_roof_assets
description: Copies a shared base name into a buffer and builds the picture and palette file paths and the floor and roof text file names, then stores the results in the related resource slots.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:7BE4
name: reset_pooled_object_lists
description: Rebuilds the object pool lists by relinking free entries and zeroing their words in several blocks, then resets the list heads and the state words that follow.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:7C74
name: delay_then_return_registers
description: Calls two routines in sequence, then returns the D0 and D1 register pair unchanged, so it passes those values through after the calls.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:7C8A
name: poll_until_flag_clear
description: Calls a poll routine repeatedly while the saved zero flag stays set, then keeps polling until the routine reports a clear flag, returning the register pair.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:7CA0
name: copy_31_word_block
description: Copies 31 consecutive 16-bit words from the source pointer to the destination pointer, advancing both.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:7CAA
name: clear_pointer_table_entries
description: Walks a null-terminated table of pointers forward and zeroes the two words each entry points to, calling a release routine before clearing any non-zero word.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:7CDA
name: clear_pointer_table_reverse
description: Walks the same kind of pointer table backwards from its end until a null entry, zeroing the two words of each entry and calling the release routine before a non-zero clear.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:7D50
name: call_single_or_pair
description: Calls one routine when the state flag is zero, otherwise calls two routines in sequence.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:7D8C
name: call_single_or_pair
description: Same as its neighbour: calls one routine when the state flag is zero, otherwise calls two routines in sequence.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:7DC8
name: swap_double_buffer_entries
description: When the mode value is negative, it swaps the two buffer pointers held in a pair of slots and exchanges the 16-bit word at offset 64 between the two buffers.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:7DF2
name: build_numbered_map_name
description: Shuffles a seven-entry index table by swapping one entry with the last, appends the chosen index as a digit to the base text (the referenced text includes com1_1 and maps/), and copies the result into the path buffer. It then fills the floor and roof name slots and writes the background colour register.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:85C2
name: run_single_pending_action
description: If the pending flag is set, it calls the stored routine, clears the flag and returns that routine's result; otherwise it returns zero.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:85DA
name: copy_next_rotating_entry
description: Advances a rotating index through five entries, wrapping to zero after four and skipping the entry that matches a second index, then copies the selected text entry into the output buffer.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:85F8
name: run_joystick_selection_menu
description: Runs a menu loop that reads selection codes from the input routine: one code switches between the two joystick labels (JOYSTICK 1 and JOYSTICK 2) and copies the chosen label into the name buffer, others set the input mode or return. It starts a new copper list and writes the background colour register.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:87C8
name: build_modem_dial_string
description: Reads a number typed as digits with backspace editing, then writes the dial prefix ATDT, the digits, a carriage return and a line feed into the output buffer. It then waits for the modem to answer and returns a status code.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:891C
name: reset_dial_state
description: Calls a routine, then clears the dial buffer marker, the input table pointer and the related cursor word.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:8934
name: manage_interrupt_requests
description: The decompiled body is empty, so only the facts are known: the routine writes the interrupt enable and interrupt request registers, and its references include the text CONNECT. The exact sequence cannot be confirmed from the code.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:8A20
name: emit_longword_bytes
description: Rotates the 32-bit value left by eight bits four times, passing each rotated value to a routine and calling a second routine after each one, so the bytes are handled in order.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:8A3A
name: read_byte_four_times
description: Calls a routine four times, each time replacing the low byte of the result with the byte returned, and returns the last byte read.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:8A8E
name: emit_string_characters
description: Passes each character of the zero-terminated string at the source pointer to a routine in turn, stopping at the terminator, and returns zero.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:8AA2
name: wait_for_connect_reply
description: Reads incoming characters, counting them, and matches them against the text CONNECT. On a full match it reads to the end of the line and returns zero; otherwise it returns minus one.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:8B0C
name: cycle_serial_baud_entry
description: Advances a rotating index through six entries, wrapping after five, copies the selected text entry into the output buffer, and stores a fixed value divided by the entry's word, minus one.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:8B22
name: apply_serial_baud_period
description: Copies the text entry for the current index, such as 2400, into the output buffer and writes the serial period register with a fixed value divided by the entry's word, minus one.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:8C90
name: fill_relative_table_entries
description: Stores the selector value and a default routine pointer, then, when a base table pointer is set, fills an output array with 15 entries read from a table of relative offsets, calling a routine before and after.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:8C98
name: fill_relative_table_entries
description: Identical to its neighbour: stores the selector value and a default routine pointer, then fills 15 output entries from a table of relative offsets when the base table pointer is set.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:8CC0
name: fill_relative_table_entries
description: Identical to its neighbour: stores the selector value and a default routine pointer, then fills 15 output entries from a table of relative offsets when the base table pointer is set.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:8D1E
name: pass_through_single_call
description: Calls one routine and returns, with no other work, so it acts as a pass-through wrapper.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:8E88
name: decrement_countdown_and_reset
description: Calls three routines, decrements a countdown word, and when the word reaches zero or was already below one, calls a routine and copies a saved value into the output, then clears it.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:8E8C
name: decrement_countdown_and_reset
description: Same countdown-and-reset as the routine before it: decrements a countdown word and, when it reaches zero, calls a routine and copies a saved value into the output, then clears it.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:8E90
name: decrement_countdown_and_reset
description: Same countdown-and-reset as its neighbours: decrements the countdown word and, at zero, calls a routine and copies the saved value into the output.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:8E94
name: decrement_countdown_and_reset
description: Same countdown-and-reset as its neighbours: decrements the countdown word and, at zero, calls a routine and copies the saved value into the output.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:8E98
name: decrement_countdown_and_reset
description: Same countdown-and-reset pattern as its neighbours, with the same decrement, zero check and output copy.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:8F18
name: decrement_countdown_and_reset
description: Same countdown-and-reset as its neighbours, and its calls include the start routine that points the copper at a new copper list.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:8F34
name: decrement_countdown_and_reset
description: Same countdown-and-reset as its neighbours, and its calls include the start routine that points the copper at a new copper list.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:8F4E
name: run_three_pending_actions
description: After two unconditional calls, checks three pending-action slots: each set slot is cleared and its stored routine called, and the result of the third routine is returned, or zero if that slot was empty.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:8F60
name: build_menu_rows
description: Initialises a menu list: stores the selected index, computes a centred starting row from the list height and the row spacing, then for each entry copies a block of rows with a 280-byte stride from the picture buffer and skips past its null-terminated label.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:8F66
name: build_menu_rows
description: Same menu row builder as its neighbour, without the initial selection reset: it copies a row block with a 280-byte stride for each entry and steps past each null-terminated label.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:8FEE
name: start_blitter_copy_row
description: Waits until the blitter is free, sets the first-word mask and the modulo values, points the source and destination at the current row, and starts a blit 20 words wide with a height taken from the row spacing.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:906C
name: measure_selected_entry_text
description: Finds the end of the text entry selected by the current index, calls a routine with it, then sets a state word to 13.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:909E
name: merge_state_flags_and_call
description: Merges two state words with values from the associated pointer, sets the upper half of one word when bit 4 or bit 5 of a state byte is set, then calls a routine and returns its result masked to the high word and bits 2 to 4.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:90F2
name: wait_until_value_changes
description: Repeatedly calls a routine until its result differs from the value held on entry, then returns that original value.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:9100
name: read_input_byte_by_mode
description: Reads values through a routine, with the result depending on the mode: in the zero mode it returns the first value once a different one arrives; otherwise it reads extra values and returns the result masked to its low byte.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:9140
name: read_direction_selection_index
description: Polls input in a loop until a stable value is seen: bit 2 steps the selection index back with wraparound, bit 3 steps it forward with wraparound, and otherwise it returns the current index.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:91C0
name: repeat_routine_count_times
description: Calls a routine a number of times equal to a stored count plus one, counting down to zero.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:91DA
name: copy_words_to_four_rows
description: Copies 23 words from a source table into four destination arrays at fixed offsets, writing each word to all four and advancing the pointers together.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:9216
name: fill_inverted_shifted_table
description: Fills 2048 output words, each taken from a source table entry at an eight-byte stride, shifted right three bits and XORed with 15.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:9238
name: decode_indexed_byte_runs
description: Reads records made of a start index byte followed by a zero-terminated run of bytes, writes each run into a table from that index onward, and stops at the end marker 255.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:924C
name: decode_indexed_byte_runs
description: Same record decoder as its neighbour, but it writes the runs into the buffer whose base address is passed in the register, until the end marker 255.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:92A0
name: process_keyboard_code
description: Rotates a raw keyboard code and sets or clears its bit in a key-state bitmap. When the press bit is clear and input is enabled it appends the mapped key code to a 32-entry ring buffer, then waits for six changes in the serial data word and acknowledges the handshake.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:9320
name: process_keyboard_code
description: Same keyboard code handler as its neighbour: it sets or clears the key's bit in the key-state bitmap, appends mapped codes to the ring buffer when input is enabled, and finishes with the six-change handshake.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:93A0
name: process_keyboard_code
description: Same keyboard code handler as its neighbours, with the same bitmap update, ring buffer append and six-change handshake.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:93C0
name: process_keyboard_code
description: Same keyboard code handler as its neighbours, with the same bitmap update, ring buffer append and six-change handshake.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:93C4
name: process_keyboard_code
description: Same keyboard code handler as its neighbours, with the same bitmap update, ring buffer append and six-change handshake.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:93E4
name: process_keyboard_code
description: Same keyboard code handler as its neighbours, which also uses the keyboard serial control and data registers, with the same bitmap update, ring buffer append and six-change handshake.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:944A
name: clear_key_state_bit
description: Clears the bit for one key in the key-state bitmap, then waits for six changes in the serial data word and clears the acknowledge bit before returning.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:9492
name: poll_library_until_nonzero
description: Calls a library function through a stored base pointer and repeats, calling a routine between tries, until the result is nonzero. It then calls two more library functions in sequence.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:94A2
name: open_file_with_retry
description: Calls a DOS library function through a stored base pointer and retries with a routine between tries until it returns a nonzero handle. It then finishes with two more DOS library calls for the write and close steps.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:9540
name: check_file_signature_header
description: Opens a file through DOS library calls and reads its header. When the four-character tag is CrM2 or CrM! and the length is above 13, it runs four routines; otherwise it runs one routine and returns.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:954C
name: check_file_signature_header
description: Same signature check as its neighbour: it reads the file header through DOS calls, and when the tag is CrM2 or CrM! with a length above 13 it runs four routines.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:95FA
name: compute_position_delta
description: When a flag is zero, it calls a routine and returns that result minus a saved base value; otherwise it returns the flag word. It then calls two library functions to finish.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:962A
name: offset_sixteen_entries
description: Computes sixteen adjusted values as each stored value minus a base value, plus two different offsets. It writes each result to two output arrays and then calls two routines.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:9682
name: convert_palette_to_grey
description: Converts each 12-bit colour entry to a grey level by summing its three 4-bit channels with an offset, clamping at 47 and dividing by three. It then writes that level into all three channels, masked by a value, until the end pointer is reached.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:96C8
name: build_darkened_palette_tables
description: Builds fifteen darkened copies of a 12-bit colour table, taking one more step off each of the three channels at each level, clamping at zero, and storing each copy with the top bit set.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:9728
name: set_control_word_once
description: When the counter is zero, it calls a routine and writes the value 416 to the shared control word. It then increments the counter and returns the byte from the routine.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:972C
name: disable_dma_channels_once
description: On the first call (when the counter is zero), it calls a routine and writes the DMA control register with the channel mask 416 and no set bit, which disables those DMA channels. It then increments the counter.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:9776
name: forbid_and_enable_dma
description: Waits until a routine returns zero, calls the exec library Forbid to stop task switching, runs another routine, then writes a DMA control value with the set bit on to enable the channels.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:979E
name: permit_multitasking
description: Calls the exec library Permit to allow task switching again, then calls a routine and returns.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:981C
name: own_blitter_and_wait
description: Takes ownership of the blitter through the graphics library, then waits until the blitter busy flag clears.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:9842
name: disown_blitter_after_wait
description: Waits until the blitter busy flag clears, then releases blitter ownership through the graphics library's DisownBlitter call.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:9868
name: fill_ascending_long_table
description: Fills 128 consecutive longs with an ascending sequence that starts at six and rises by four per entry, continuing across four blocks of 32.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:98B2
name: compute_blit_parameters
description: Computes the blit fields for the current row: a pointer offset from a base value with a scroll step, a control word of 256 or 2544 depending on a mask test, and two row bounds from the vertical position and height. It returns when done.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:98B6
name: compute_blit_parameters
description: Same blit parameter computation as its neighbour, with the same control word choice of 256 or 2544 and the same row bounds.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:9926
name: write_bitplane_copper_pointers
description: Writes six bitplane pointers into a copper list with each plane 40 bytes after the last, then stores the display window control words, the modulo value and the remaining pointer words.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:99A8
name: write_copper_pointer_pair
description: Writes a 32-bit address into a copper list as two 16-bit words at fixed offsets, the high word and the low word each in its own slot.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:99BE
name: restore_display_copper_list
description: Calls the graphics library LoadView, waits for the top of frame twice, points the copper at the saved list, then writes the DMA control register with the set bit and 416 to re-enable those channels.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:99F8
name: open_graphics_and_setup_buffers
description: Opens graphics.library through exec, stores its base and a view field, allocates the new buffer through a routine, and copies a block of saved words into it. It then sets the sub-buffer pointers and copper address halves at fixed offsets, and finishes with LoadView and a frame wait.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:99FC
name: open_graphics_and_setup_buffers
description: Opens graphics.library and sets up the same copper bitmap buffers as its neighbour, copying saved words into the new buffer and storing the sub-buffer and copper address halves, then finishes with LoadView and a frame wait.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:9AE4
name: compute_buffer_dimensions
description: Multiplies the width and height fields to store a size, computes the second product, stores a byte stride of the row count times 280, and calls a routine twice to store two buffer pointers in the structure.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:9B56
name: decode_rle_image_rows
description: Decodes a run-length compressed image into rows 40 bytes wide: a positive count copies that many literal bytes, a negative count repeats the next byte, and a control value of 128 is skipped. The height is capped at 240 rows.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:9BAC
name: decode_image_into_bitplanes
description: When the buffer pointer is empty, it sets one bit per pixel across each bitplane row from a seven-bit pattern and copies 489 longs into the destination. Otherwise it decodes the image rows the same way as its neighbour, at a 40-byte stride.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:9C2C
name: copy_longs_one_row_down
description: Copies a block of longs equal to the input count times 70 from the start of the buffer to the place 70 longs later, which is one 280-byte row further on.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:9C42
name: free_three_buffer_slots
description: Clears three buffer pointer slots in a structure, calling a release routine for each of the first two that was set, and returns the result of the release routine for the third, or zero if it was empty.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:9C84
name: build_copper_list
description: Builds a copper list in the structure. In one mode it writes a fixed set of colour and control moves followed by a table of palette entries; otherwise it computes the list size from the width and height and fills a move and wait entry for each row, then copies the finished list into a second buffer.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:9DF2
name: write_four_signed_bytes
description: Writes four signed bytes into the destination: the supplied value minus one, then the fixed values minus 31, minus 1 and minus 2.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:9E06
name: allocate_tracked_block
description: Allocates a block through the exec library and records its size and link fields in a list of tracked blocks. If allocation fails it writes a colour value to the background register in a loop, then returns the usable address.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:9E10
name: allocate_tracked_header_block
description: Allocates a 16-byte header block through the exec library, links it into the tracked block list with its size and a stored value, and returns the address just past the header. If allocation fails it writes a colour value to the background register.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:9E64
name: free_all_tracked_blocks
description: Walks the list of tracked blocks, unlinking each entry and passing it to the exec library FreeMem until the list is empty.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:9E8E
name: free_tracked_block_at
description: Searches the tracked block list for the entry matching the given address, unlinks it and frees it through the exec library. If no entry matches, it writes a colour value to the background register and returns zero.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:9EE0
name: resolve_relative_pointer_table
description: Converts five relative offsets stored at a base address into absolute pointers and saves them in slot variables. It also derives one more pointer from the base minus 100 and copies one pointer slot into another.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:9F44
name: run_and_clear_slot_table
description: Walks eight pointer slots, calling a stored routine for each non-zero slot and clearing that slot. It returns the result of the last routine called.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:9F62
name: resolve_eight_named_entries
description: Copies each of eight null-terminated names from a table into a buffer and calls a routine to resolve it, storing each result. For every nonzero result it fills twenty longs with offsets that step by 4160, and the referenced text txts/ marks the directory these names belong to.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:9FD6
name: repeat_shifted_count_calls
description: Computes a repeat count by shifting one stored value left by the amount in a second field and subtracting one, then calls a routine that many times in a loop.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:A016
name: repeat_shifted_count_calls
description: Same repeat count calculation as its neighbour: shifts a stored value by a second field, then calls a routine in a counted loop.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:A050
name: remap_bytes_through_table
description: Replaces each byte in a range with the entry from a lookup table indexed by that byte's value, and returns the last original byte read.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:A06E
name: build_index_byte_map
description: Writes seven descending values at the top of a table, then for each input word searches a growing list of values, appending new ones. It stores each word's list position as a byte, and writes a colour to the background register if a position exceeds 255.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:22FC8
name: store_value_return_255
description: Stores its input value in a shared word and returns 255.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:22FEC
name: stub_bad_instruction_data
description: Calls an unresolved routine that is not part of the game code, then returns. The decoder read this gap as code, so it is a stub or bad data.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:22FFC
name: store_word_value
description: Stores its input value in a shared word and returns.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:23004
name: stub_bad_instruction_data
description: Calls an unresolved routine that is not part of the game code, then returns. The decoder read this gap as code, so it is a stub or bad data.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:24DC4
name: dispatch_by_signature_tag
description: Compares the four-character tag at the input pointer with CrM! and CrM2. It calls one routine for CrM! and a different routine for CrM2, and does nothing for other tags.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:24F00
name: decode_compressed_stream
description: Decodes a compressed stream: it clears a 16-long table, reads bit-coded tokens through a lookup routine, and either writes a literal byte or copies a run of earlier output from a distance computed from a shifted bit count.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:24FB2
name: decode_huffman_symbol
description: Reads bits one at a time from a stream of 16-bit words, building a code until its length matches an entry in a count table. It then returns the symbol at the matching position in a second table.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:25018
name: read_length_tables
description: Reads a count, then that many values through a lookup routine into one array while summing them. It then reads a second array whose length is the sum minus one.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:25056
name: fill_array_with_accumulated_values
description: Writes zero to the first entry, then for fifteen source values it stores running sums into two destination arrays, with each sum built from the previous ones.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:28838
name: open_library_and_link_entry
description: Opens a library through an exec call and clears twelve bytes of local state. When the test value passes it allocates a block, copies a text name into it and links it into the record list, then closes the libraries; otherwise it closes them directly.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:28878
name: apply_patch_record_list
description: Walks a list of patch records, each introduced by a marker word, and dispatches each marker through a switch that opens libraries, looks up addresses and compares version fields before applying the patch.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:setpatch:0:0000
name: run_setpatch_main
description: Program entry point of the setpatch installer. It opens the exec and dos libraries, reads the cache option and the QUIET, NOCACHE and REVERSE switches, applies the patch list, and reports either that the disk needs Kickstart 2.0 or later or that the patches are already installed.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:setpatch:0:08B0
name: check_a3000_and_run_patch
description: Checks a system value through an exec call. When a bit is set, it allocates a block, copies a 51-word table into it, runs the patch calls between Forbid and Permit, then frees the block; the referenced text is A3000 bonus.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:setpatch:0:08BE
name: run_patch_block_if_68030
description: When the processor flag bit is set, it allocates a block, copies a 51-word table into it, runs the library calls between Forbid and Permit, then frees the block and returns one. Otherwise it returns zero.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:setpatch:0:08CA
name: run_patch_block_unconditionally
description: Allocates a block, copies a 51-word table into it, runs the library calls between Forbid and Permit, then frees the block and returns one. It uses the exec calls AllocMem, Forbid, Permit and FreeMem.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:setpatch:0:0924
name: set_cache_control_byte
description: If a status byte is not 127, it scans downward for a word that matches its own address, derives a bit value from the result, and writes the control byte with the matching bits set and cleared.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:setpatch:0:09E0
name: test_68030_flag_bit
description: Returns bit 3 of the processor attribute word in the exec base, which is nonzero when the flag for the 68030 processor is set.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:setpatch:0:0A4C
name: free_patch_slots
description: Frees a stored block at one slot and then five further slots through the exec FreeMem call, clearing each freed slot and its paired field, and returns one.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:setpatch:0:0B0C
name: dispatch_io_request_state
description: Checks a request state word: one state copies the saved fields back and clears them, another clears the pending field, and both then reply through the exec ReplyMsg routine. Any other state calls a stored routine instead.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:setpatch:0:0B10
name: dispatch_io_request_state
description: Same request state dispatch as its neighbour, replying through the exec ReplyMsg routine for the matching states and calling a stored routine for any other state.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:setpatch:0:0B26
name: complete_io_request_reply
description: When the request's first byte is 4, it copies the saved fields back, clears its state and replies with the exec ReplyMsg routine. Otherwise it calls a stored routine.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:setpatch:0:0B6A
name: reply_request_when_idle
description: When the request's pending field is zero, it copies the saved field back, clears the flag and replies to the message through the ReplyMsg routine. Otherwise it calls a stored routine.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:setpatch:0:0BB4
name: call_cia_resource_pair
description: Calls two routines and returns zero. The referenced text ciaa.resource and ciab.resource names the two CIA resources involved.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:setpatch:0:0BD2
name: update_node_with_frame_wait
description: Looks up a node through a library call and, when its flag byte is negative, disables interrupts, marks the node, waits for the frame, re-enables interrupts and clears the flag. It returns the node.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:setpatch:0:0CA4
name: pass_through_single_call
description: A two-instruction routine that calls one other routine. The decompiler timed out, so no further behaviour is recovered.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:setpatch:0:0CAC
name: stub_single_instruction
description: A single-instruction routine called by one caller. The decompiler timed out, so its behaviour cannot be confirmed beyond that.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:setpatch:0:0CB2
name: pass_through_single_call
description: Calls one routine and returns, with no other work.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:setpatch:0:0D4C
name: find_console_device_resident
description: Finds the console.device resident module through an exec call and, when it is found, stores its address, its version field and the exec base in shared variables.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:setpatch:0:0D70
name: call_within_range_only
description: If the argument lies between the stored lower and upper bounds, it calls one routine and, when that returns a value, calls another with it. Otherwise it jumps through a stored routine pointer.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:setpatch:0:0D78
name: call_stored_routine
description: Calls the routine whose address is stored in a shared variable, then returns.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:setpatch:0:0D7E
name: call_if_below_bound
description: If the input value is at most the stored upper bound, it calls one routine and, when that succeeds, calls a second library routine. Otherwise it calls the stored routine pointer.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:setpatch:0:0E44
name: store_shared_pointer
description: Stores its input value in a shared variable and returns.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:setpatch:0:0E48
name: store_shared_pointer
description: Writes its input value into a shared variable, the same as its neighbour, and returns.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:setpatch:0:0E52
name: release_patch_resources
description: Closes a library opened earlier through the exec CloseLibrary call, then walks a list of entries calling a library routine for each and clearing an entry's field when that call fails. It finishes with two more library calls and returns one.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:setpatch:0:0E9E
name: finish_patch_release
description: Calls two library routines and returns one, which finishes the release of patch resources.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:setpatch:0:0F28
name: search_patch_table_names
description: Loops over a patch table entry by entry, looking up each through a library call and checking a condition on it, with Forbid calls between checks. It returns the index of the match, or zero if none is found.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:setpatch:0:0F2C
name: match_patch_names_by_pattern
description: Loops over the patch table, matching each entry's name against a wildcard pattern through the DOS MatchPattern call, and returns the first matching index, or zero if none matches. The referenced pattern text is ~(#?).

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:setpatch:0:0FAE
name: search_patch_table_from
description: Stores a start value in a field, then loops over the patch table, matching entries and calling a routine on each candidate, and returns the index found.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:setpatch:0:0FC8
name: process_patch_file_entries
description: Clears a counter, then looks up a resource through library calls at offsets -102 and -228 and walks a list of entries, calling a routine on each and counting those that pass. It closes the resource and returns zero, or an error code when a check fails.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:setpatch:0:1016
name: process_patch_list_entries
description: For a count between one and seven, walks a linked list of patch entries, calling a check routine on each and counting those that pass, then closes the list. It returns minus one when a check fails.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:setpatch:0:1028
name: process_patch_list_until_end
description: Walks a patch entry list in a do-while loop, calling a check routine on each entry and counting the entries that pass. A failed check returns minus one; otherwise it closes the list and returns zero.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:setpatch:0:1052
name: process_patch_list_with_checks
description: Walks the patch list with a while loop that tests each entry's conditions and advances the list pointer. It returns minus one on a failed check, and otherwise closes the list and returns zero.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:setpatch:0:1084
name: process_patch_list_nested
description: Walks the patch list with nested loops, calling check routines and counting entries. It returns zero when the list ends normally and minus one when a check fails.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:setpatch:0:10C4
name: write_patch_record_fields
description: Works out how many bytes a patch record needs from its field count and the lengths of its name strings. It returns zero if the remaining space is too small; otherwise it subtracts that size and copies the name strings and field words into the record.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:setpatch:0:10F6

name: write_patch_record_known_size
description: Rounds a precomputed record size up to an even value, subtracts it from the remaining space, then copies the name strings and field words into the record according to the field count.

description: Chooses a table base, either a fixed location or one returned by a library call when a flag bit is set, then scans forward until the entry equals the stored key, stores that position, flushes the cache through the library routine at offset -636, and returns one.

description: Same test as its neighbour: calls the stored hook when the word at its address is not the branch-to-subroutine opcode, otherwise it calls the other routine.

description: When a library check returns nonzero, it measures the input string, allocates a buffer one byte larger with AllocVec, copies the string into it with its length stored first, terminates it, and passes the buffer to a library routine. If allocation fails it frees the buffer through FreeVec and returns zero.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:setpatch:0:193C
name: build_bcpl_name_in_place
description: Measures the string at the input pointer, shifts it up by one byte with its length stored first, terminates it, and passes the counted string to a library routine.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:setpatch:0:1962
name: build_bcpl_name_from_length
description: Shifts a counted run of bytes up by one position, stores the length byte in front, terminates the result, and passes it to a library routine.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:setpatch:0:1A88
name: decrement_nesting_and_permit
description: Increments a counter at a fixed offset, decrements a nesting count in the structure, and when the count reaches zero clears the owner and processes the waiting list. It calls the exec Permit routine to release task switching, and calls two routines when the status is negative.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:setpatch:0:1AA0
name: decrement_or_alert_count
description: When the status flag is negative, it calls the exec Alert and InitSemaphore routines. Otherwise it decrements a count, then calls the exec Permit routine.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:setpatch:0:1AA8
name: alert_and_init_semaphore
description: Calls the exec Alert routine, then InitSemaphore, and then Permit to release task switching.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:setpatch:0:1ACA
name: release_waiting_list_entries
description: Takes the first entry of a list and unlinks it. When its flag bit is set it walks the rest of the waiting list, calling a library routine for each flagged entry, then calls the exec Permit routine.
